clues.text: When God asked Moses what was in his hand, he named this, and thrown down it became a snake.
Before Pharaoh, the one Aaron threw down swallowed up those thrown down by Egypt's magicians.
Twelve were placed before the LORD in the Tent of the Testimony, and Aaron's sprouted, blossomed and produced almonds overnight.
Tamar asked Judah for his seal, his cord, and this from his hand as a pledge.
Elisha sent his servant Gehazi ahead to lay this on a dead boy's face, but the boy did not wake.
With Pharaoh's army behind them, God told Moses to lift this up and stretch his hand over the sea to divide it.
In the wilderness, Moses struck the rock twice with this, and water gushed out for the people and livestock.
